# Lyrics

Song lyrics storage and retrieval. Integrates with the [LRCLIB API](https://lrclib.net/docs) to fetch both plain and synced/timed lyrics (LRC format). Full four-layer DDD structure.

## Concepts

The `Lyrics` aggregate stores lyrics indexed by song ID, supporting multiple sources (embedded tags, LRCLIB, Musixmatch, Genius). Each record holds both `plainLyrics` and `syncedLyrics` (LRC format with `[mm:ss.xx]` timestamps for karaoke-style display). An optional `lrclibId` records the LRCLIB record the lyrics came from; several songs can share one record, such as one recording on an album and a compilation.

**Aggregate root:** `Lyrics` (state object pattern via `LyricsState`)

**LRCLIB integration strategy:**
- Fetch: one request to `/api/get` with the song's signature. A song that has lyrics keeps them; the fetch returns them without calling LRCLIB
- Pace and pause: `LrclibClient` reserves a turn for every request under the `lrclib` rate limiter in Redis, one request every two seconds for all processes together, in `dev` as well; `test` raises the limit. A 429, or a 503 with `Retry-After`, stores a pause every process waits out (`RedisLrclibPause`, key `lyrics:lrclib:pause`, whose expiry is the pause): the seconds the header names, an hour at most, or 5 and then 15 when it names none, and a later answer never shortens it. The request is sent again after the pause, three sends at most. Each call has one deadline, its `LrclibWait`: 10 seconds for a request someone waits on (per-song fetch, search, apply), 30 for a queued fetch. A request that cannot be sent before the deadline is not sent, and the call returns `LrclibUnavailable`
- Outcomes: `FetchLyricsHandler` returns a `LyricsFetchResult` whose `LyricsFetchOutcome` is found, no match, no artist, no length, rejected or unavailable. It never throws for any of them, so queued fetches end without a retry. A song without a primary artist credit, or whose length is missing or not positive, is not looked up. The per-song API route and `app:song:lyrics:fetch` turn every outcome except found and no match into an error that exits with 1: no artist and no length into `LyricsFetchNotAttemptedException` (HTTP 409, `details.reason` `song_has_no_artist` or `song_has_no_length`), rejected into `LyricsRequestRejectedException` (409, `lrclib_rejected`), and unavailable into `LyricsProviderUnavailableException` (503). Search and apply report a rejection and an outage the same way. Apply refuses a song that has lyrics with `SongHasLyricsException` (409, `song_has_lyrics`); a result another song already has is stored for this song too
- LRCLIB answers: 404 is no match. Any other 4xx except 408 and 429 is a rejected request; sending it again gets the same answer. 408, redirects, server errors, timeouts, transport failures, unreadable bodies and a rate-limit answer to the third send mean LRCLIB is unavailable. Signature lookups send the song's length rounded to the nearest second
- Search fallback: manual keyword search via `/api/search` when auto-match by track signature fails. The search route requires `ROLE_ADMIN`, as fetch and apply do, because each search takes a turn of the shared pace
- Bulk fetch: `BulkFetchLyricsHandler` walks the songs without lyrics and queues one fetch per song on the `async` transport, spaced by the run's delay: 3,000 ms by default, and a smaller delay is raised to that. It skips a song without a primary artist credit or a positive length, the rule `LyricsLookupRequirements` shares with `FetchLyricsHandler`, and counts it per cause. `app:lyrics:fetch` and `POST /api/admin/lyrics/bulk-fetch` report the queued and skipped counts
- Bulk run tally: `QueuedLyricsFetchesInterface` keeps each run's queued marks, its cancellation and its tally in Redis; each entry expires a day after the fetches it covers are due. The walk records its skipped counts and its job when it finishes, also when it queued nothing; each queued fetch then counts found, no match, rejected or unavailable once per run and song. A fetch skipped because its run was cancelled, or whose song was deleted, counts toward no outcome. The sync status reports the run whose walk finished last as `latestRun`
- Automatic fetch: while `lyrics.auto_fetch` is on, Catalog ingest queues one fetch on the `async` transport for each new song without a sidecar `.lrc` file, and for each stored song without sidecar lyrics whose repair, as on a rescan, gives it a primary artist credit or a new length. The setting is off by default and does not gate the bulk scan or the on-demand fetch.

## Ports

| Port | Layer | Purpose |
|------|-------|---------|
| `LyricsPortInterface` | Application | Reads the stored lyrics of a song |
| `LrclibClientInterface` | Application | LRCLIB HTTP API contract (getBySignature, search, getById); null or an empty list for a miss, `LrclibRejected` for a refused request, `LrclibUnavailable` for an outage or a request that could not be sent within its `LrclibWait` |
| `LyricsFetchRequestInterface` | Application (contract) | Lets Catalog ingest request fetches for new and repaired songs; reads `lyrics.auto_fetch` on every call |
| `AlbumLyricsMergePortInterface` | Application (contract) | Lets Catalog's album merge move a duplicate song's lyrics to the kept song when it has none, as one statement inside the merge's transaction (`AlbumLyricsMerge`) |
| `QueuedLyricsFetchesInterface` | Application | Bulk runs' queued marks, cancellations and outcome tallies, in Redis (`RedisQueuedLyricsFetches`, which also cancels a finished job's fetches for the job monitor) |
| `LyricsAdminPortInterface` | Application | Coverage and sync status behind the admin lyrics routes and their commands; the sync status includes the latest bulk run's tally |

## Events

No domain events published yet.

## Interactions

### API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/songs/{publicId}/lyrics` | Get cached lyrics for a song |
| POST | `/api/songs/{publicId}/lyrics/fetch` | Trigger on-demand LRCLIB fetch |
| GET | `/api/lyrics/search?q=...` | Search LRCLIB |
| POST | `/api/lyrics/search/{resultId}/apply` | Apply search result to a song |

### Console Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `app:lyrics:fetch` | Queue a lyrics fetch from LRCLIB for every song without lyrics, or up to `--limit` |
| `app:lyrics:coverage` | Lyrics coverage, as the admin coverage endpoint returns it |
| `app:lyrics:status` | Lyrics job counts and the latest bulk run's tally, as the admin sync-status endpoint returns them |
| `app:song:lyrics:fetch` | Fetch the lyrics of one song from LRCLIB, as the per-song fetch route does |
| `app:lyrics:search` | Search LRCLIB and list the results with their IDs |
| `app:lyrics:apply` | Store an LRCLIB search result as the lyrics of a song that has none |

### Cross-Context Dependencies

| Dependency | Layer | Purpose |
|------------|-------|---------|
| `Catalog\Application\Port\SongLookupInterface` | Application, Interface | Visible song ID by public ID and library scope; song-ID pages for the bulk scan; the LRCLIB signature (title, artist name, album title, duration) of one song or of a page of songs, as `SongLyricSignature` |

`LyricsEntity` stores a scalar `song_id`. `LyricsForeignKeys` declares the `fk_lyrics_song_id` constraint (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), so deleting a song still deletes its lyrics. An album merge moves a duplicate song's lyrics to the kept song before it deletes the duplicate, through `AlbumLyricsMergePortInterface`.

### Anti-Corruption Layer

LRCLIB API is isolated behind `LrclibClientInterface` → `LrclibClient` (Symfony HttpClient). The application layer never depends on external API details.
